scenario_tests.need: Parent wants a basic overview and next steps after an autism diagnosis
scenario_tests.potential_addition: Short county-specific contact path; distinguish education, therapies, county DD eligibility and parent support.
scenario_tests.validation_question: Can the parent identify the right next office and what to ask without extra searching?

scenario_tests.need: Parent is concerned about a young child's development
scenario_tests.potential_addition: Visible referral entry point with age/life-stage signposting; route older children to the appropriate school/county path.
scenario_tests.validation_question: Can the family reach the correct referral page and understand what happens next?

scenario_tests.need: Parent needs evaluation or school support
scenario_tests.potential_addition: County/school district contact and linked evaluation roadmap; family advocacy contacts after verification.
scenario_tests.validation_question: Can the family identify who receives its request and how to follow up?

scenario_tests.need: Senior or disabled adult needs help at home
scenario_tests.potential_addition: Distinguish skilled health care from personal assistance; verify service area, intake contact, payment participation and availability.
scenario_tests.validation_question: Can the person find a serving provider and a coverage/eligibility contact?

scenario_tests.potential_addition: Verified local respite options and routes to funding/application support.
scenario_tests.validation_question: Can the caregiver get an actionable next contact rather than an organization name?

scenario_tests.need: Disabled veteran needs a ramp or mobility help
scenario_tests.potential_addition: Link county benefits assistance to relevant funding, assessment and installation/repair contacts; review VHG home adaptation materials before reuse.
scenario_tests.validation_question: Does the pathway connect funding assistance and delivery, including an alternative when the first option cannot help?

scenario_tests.need: Nursing home staff or family seeks support for a resident or transition home
scenario_tests.potential_addition: Facility social services contact, community support navigator and a plain-language referral checklist.
scenario_tests.validation_question: Can the staff member hand off the need to a specific responsible service?

gap_validation.sample: Proposed: 5 families/caregivers plus 2 facility staff; no interviews performed
gap_validation.method: Use representative tasks in existing tools, then the proposed pathways; record whether people reach an appropriate contact, time taken, dead ends, eligibility confusion and missing alternatives.
gap_validation.publication_gate: Verify current facility identity/status, public contacts, county/service area, and intended use before publishing.
